text:
My main project is trying not to lose my mind, given all the things I can now create thanks to AI.

Jokes aside (although I'm not entirely joking about my mental health), my main project is https://auradistill.com: First-principles thinking for your AI agents.

It's not just about giving your personal AI agents "memory". It's about encoding memories in a way that can handle ambiguity and contradictions.

That project alone has got me completely hooked on building for and with LLMs.

I've got other projects too, but this is probably the one I've poured the most time and energy into.
